goal: Record a MEMBER INQUIRY BY LAST NAME capability. Sign on as operator teller1 ([REDACTED:SECRET] is a secret parameter, already supplied). On the Member Inquiry / Selection screen, set the 'Search by' dropdown to Last Name, enter the last name 'Hopper' in the Value box, and run the search. From the results table extract the matched member's member number and the number of shares as typed outputs, then finish on the results screen.

notes.note: Searching a last name with no match shows exactly: "No member records matched your search." on the Member Inquiry / Selection screen, with no results table. This is a legitimate business answer.
Submitting Search with the Value box empty simply re-renders the inquiry screen (URL gains ?by=number&q=) with no error message and no results table — no validation text is displayed.
Results table columns are "Member No.", "Name", "Shares", plus a Select link per row. A last-name search may return multiple rows; this capability extracts from the first matched row.

finish.name: Member Inquiry by Last Name
finish.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console with the supplied operator credentials, opens Member Inquiry / Selection, searches by Last Name, and returns the matched member's member number and share count from the results table. If no member matches, reports a no_member_match business outcome.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the console.

inputs.name: lastName
inputs.description: Member last name to search for.

outputs.name: memberNumber
outputs.description: Member number of the first matched member in the results table.

outputs.name: shares
outputs.description: Number of shares shown for the matched member.

outputs.name: memberName
outputs.description: Displayed member name (Last, First) of the matched row.

businessOutcomes.title: No member records matched the search
businessOutcomes.detectValue: No member records matched your search.

businessOutcomes.title: Session expired and operator must sign on again
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Re-run the capability; if it recurs, check operator credentials and console session limits.
